name: docs-qa
description: RAG-based documentation Q&A with faithful citations and honest abstention.

scripts.setup: bun run corpus && bun run ingest
scripts.eval:all: bun run eval:d2 && bun run eval:d4 && bun run eval:d5 && bun run eval:d6 && bun run eval:d7

scripts-notes.corpus: Regenerate the 20-page Lumen corpus from scripts (writes data/corpus/*.md). Deterministic, no network.
scripts-notes.ingest: Chunk + embed + insert into data/lumen.db. Content-hash cached; re-runs make zero API calls.
scripts-notes.setup: Cold start: corpus + ingest. Run once after cloning.
scripts-notes.smoke:chunks: Print chunker stats + a random sample of 10 chunks (readability check).
scripts-notes.smoke:rerank: Run union + LLM rerank on 2 sample queries; prints per-candidate scores.
scripts-notes.smoke:generate: Run full pipeline on 2 sample queries; prints answer + resolved citations.
scripts-notes.eval:d2: Vector-only baseline on 20 in-scope queries. Reports hit@1/3/5/10 + MRR.
scripts-notes.eval:d3: Vector vs BM25 vs RRF hybrid comparison (D3 experiment, retained for reference).
scripts-notes.eval:d4: Union + LLM rerank on 20 queries. Target hit@1 ≥ 90%.
scripts-notes.eval:d5: Generation + citation compliance on 20 queries. Target compliance ≥ 90%.
scripts-notes.eval:d6:calibrate: Score in-scope and off-scope queries to pick the abstention threshold.
scripts-notes.eval:d7: Faithfulness via claim extraction + entailment. Target ≥ 0.90.
scripts-notes.eval:all: Run retrieval, generation, abstention, faithfulness evals in order.
